title: access: an external object on the default sharing model refuses every member edit (403) because the ownership checks read `owner_id` / `created_by`, which no remote row carries — `os validate` says nothing (epic #27261, found by the P0 spike)
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ① product defect, class c, reach measured through the public HTTP door.
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) routes it after triage sets the lane; the fix PR is the `os validate` warning below. #27278 (the guide) carries the author-facing rule meanwhile.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "external federated object sharing model owner_id created_by 403 member edit" → 20 hits, none this defect (#26596 is the public_read_write write-floor change, #23268 the retired `externalSharingModel`); "external object datasource sharingModel owner column validate warning ADR-0015" → 19 hits, none this defect.
reach: public HTTP entry, measured: `PATCH /api/v1/data/spike_owned/o_1` by a member whose permission set grants `allowEdit` answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` — pinned as step (e3) in `packages/runtime/src/plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` (PR #27330, head `680ce37b`).
type: Bug

Part of #27261 (Tier A, ruling 6471382887). Found by the P0 spike #27276; its report is comment 6476152968 on #27276.

## 维护者速读

- **现象：** 外部对象（`external` 绑定）若沿用默认共享模型，持有 `allowEdit` 的普通成员改任何一行都被 403；只有管理员或 `sharingModel: public_read_write` 才能写。
- **原因：** 写之前平台问远端两件事：共享检查读 `owner_id`，所有权兜底读 `created_by == 当前用户`。远端行没有这两列，于是永远判「不是你的」。
- **影响：** #27130 这类虚拟对象的作者照默认写，上线后成员拖甘特条全部 403，且 `os validate` 不提示。
- **最小修法：** `os validate` 对「外部对象 + 按所有者的共享模型 + 未映射所有者列」给警告，点名两条出路（改 `public_read_write` 由 hook 判谁能改，或在 `columnMap` 映射一列所有者）。不做 defineStack 拒收（那会收窄已发布接受集）。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Evidence

The spike's second external object `spike_owned` (no `sharingModel`, so the platform default) on the plugin driver `driver.spike_tree`. The member holds `{ allowRead: true, allowEdit: true }` on it. Before refusing, the remote is asked exactly:

- `find { where: { id: 'o_1' }, fields: ['id', 'owner_id'], limit: 1 }` (the sharing check), and
- `findOne { where: { $and: [{ id: 'o_1' }, { created_by: <caller> }] }, limit: 1 }` (the ownership floor).

Neither column exists on a remote row, so every row reads as someone else's; `driver.update` is never called. On `sharingModel: 'public_read_write'` the same member's write reaches `beforeUpdate` and then `driver.update` (steps e1/e2 of the same file).

## Task

- [ ] `os validate` warning (not a refusal) for an object with an `external` binding whose effective sharing model is owner-keyed and whose `external.columnMap` maps no owner column; the message names both ways out.
- [ ] Pin: the spike's `spike_owned` shape gets the warning; the `spike_node` shape (`public_read_write`) does not.
- [ ] Check whether the same two reads also refuse `delete`, and name it in the PR.

`Clause-②: no` (a warning narrows nothing) · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
